node.title: L1 fixed-support codeword quotient bound
node.statement: For one source chart and exact petal support X of size h, fix one compatible degree-at-most-(k-1) codeword P_0. Every other compatible codeword injects by (P-P_0)/L_X into polynomials of degree at most (k-1)-h, so the cell has size at most q^max(0,k-h). Every fixed (p,(k-1)-h) box is polynomial per source chart with bound (P+1)n^(1/c_0+P+gamma(E+1)). In sub-Johnson variables a=(k-1)-d and s=h-d, a bounded-polarity counterfamily must therefore have a-s=(k-1)-h unbounded. No splitting property of the quotient is asserted.
